entries.reasoning: With Up payoff a against Left and0 otherwise, and Down payoff b against Right and0 otherwise, indifference is ap=b(1-p), hence p=b/(a+b). Revised unequal payoffs yield varied probabilities strictly between0 and1. This is an opponent mixing probability that makes this player indifferent, not a full equilibrium without the other player payoffs.
